title: The Sky-Room Where Parallel Lines Dance

features.name: converging-line thread
features.desc-on-touch: You touch where two lines approach, become parallel, and in the space where they ought to touch, something dances — a logic that moves like water, mathematical and alive.

features.name: horizon-choice marker
features.desc-on-touch: You read a glyph that shifts: sometimes it reads as arrival, sometimes as departure, never as a choice that was made.

features.name: dual-path schematic
features.desc-on-touch: You see the archive has mapped both roads, both homes. Here they are drawn at once, occupying the same space, superimposed — the place where parallel stopped being impossible.

features.name: blue-grid ceiling
features.desc-on-touch: You look up and the sky is all grid, all right angles. You could call it a room. You could call it the sky. The distinction has learned to mean nothing here.

inscription: here parallel lines learned that dreams do not obey compass directions

file.name: Ridge_Parallel_Road_Dream_Schematic_Unknown_Date.log
file.note: A technical record, but the coordinates disagree with themselves; the routes describe the same destination while moving in opposite directions

reverie.title: REVERIE — roads at the ridge before one was chosen
narr: You both stand where the ridge is flattest, two paths
stretching toward different tomorrows. She says: the archive
wants to preserve both. He says: but we cannot walk twice.
Motes drift past. She touches the fork in the ground.
The earth doesn't care which way you went, she says.
But I do, he says. She nods. So does the archive.

exits.label: upward where the grid resolves into sky
